name: LinuxCNC waterjet
description: LinuxCNC-style waterjet in millimetres. Absolute moves, cutter compensation and tool length cancelled, path blend G64 P0.05 as on the plasma post, not a measured machine setting. Controller left or right compensation writes G41 or G42 before the first feed and G40 at the end; computed compensation stays on the already-offset path. The jet is a Torch process: on is M3 S1 and off is M5, the same LinuxCNC spindle-control words as plasma. Named Other process abrasive is M64 Pn / M65 Pn; digital_out.abrasive_pin is a post parameter that defaults to 0, not a machine assignment. Any other Other name is refused. The pierce delay is the path dwell (G4 P in seconds). Arcs use IJK and helices are written as lines. thc.on and thc.off stay empty until a manual cites height-control codes. process_cycle is per_cut: abrasive off then jet off before a rapid, jet on then abrasive on before the next feed. A pierce dwell is written only when the IR has one at that cut. No rotary axis. Not proven on a machine.
